causeCollection.description:
A lower-level set of structured errors.

Only oneOf `causeWrapped`, `causeSimple`, `causeCollection`, or `causeIndexedCollection` will ever be set.

causeIndexedCollection.description:
A lower-level set of structured errors.
Each of these errors MUST have index set.

Only oneOf `causeWrapped`, `causeSimple`, `causeCollection`, or `causeIndexedCollection` will ever be set.

causeIsInternal.description: If true, then the cause (`causeWrapped`, `causeSimple`, `causeCollection`, or `causeIndexedCollection`) should be hidden from the user.

causeSimple.description:
Simple string error type.

Only oneOf `causeWrapped`, `causeSimple`, `causeCollection`, or `causeIndexedCollection` will ever be set.

domain.description:
The "domain" for the error.  If empty, it is an EDA
core error.  Alternatively it can be an EDA application
"apiVersion" value (e.g. interfaces.eda.nokia.com/v1alpha1)
indicating that the error is specific to that application.
The domain gives the receiver information that they can use
to help them interpret the "type" field.

index.description:
When processing an array, errors may be generated related to a particular array item.
If set, this index indicates to which array item the error applies.

message.description: The basic text error message for the error response.

ref.description: Reference to the error source. Should typically be the URI of the request.

type.description:
Type defines a unique identifier for the error, within the domain.
This may be used (along with the domain) to find an internationalization translation for the message.

SHOULD be a valid golang identifier, and SHOULD be in UpperCamelCase.

values.description:
Associated data/information.
The error "message" may contain {{name}} escapes that should be substituted with information from this dictionary.

Note that this map MUST NOT contain JSON objects (`{...}`) or arrays (`[...]`), only simple JSON types are permitted.

ErrorResponse.title: Generic error response for REST APIs.

K8SPatchOp.description: The definition for a JSON patch for a resource, as in RFC 6902

from.description:
Only applies to a "move" operation, and is the path to the field/value within
the target JSON object that should be moved to the location specified by the "path"
field.

op.description: The type of operation this patch should perform.

path.description:
The path to the field within the target JSON object
that should be patched according to the "op" field.

value.description:
This field would be set to the value which the user intends to put in the
field referenced by the "path" field.  The type of the value should match
the type of the field as indicated by the schema of the resource being
patched.

x-permissive.description:
For an "add" operation, an already-present field referenced by the "path" will
result in an error unless this field is true.  Similarly for a non-existent
target field of a "remove" operation.

x-ui-annotation.description: Metadata maintained in support of the EDA UI.  External use not recommended.

spec.description:
BotSpec defines the desired state of Bot.

A Bot is bound to exactly one Discord server (guild). To target
multiple servers, create one Bot CR per server. This keeps
notification fan-out, RBAC and rate-limit accounting per-server and
avoids a single bot becoming a multi-tenant routing layer.

allowedChannels.description:
Channels in the server this bot is allowed to read messages from
and post into. Notifications and slash commands are restricted
to this list.

presence.description:
Presence (status / activity) the bot should maintain while
connected.

serverDescription.description: Free-form description of the server, shown in the UI.
serverDescription.title: Server Description

serverID.description: Discord server (guild) ID this bot is bound to.

key.description: Key inside the Secret holding the value.
key.title: Secret Key

tokenRef.title: Token

spec.title: Specification

heartbeat acknowledged by Discord.

spec.description: NotificationSpec defines the desired state of Notification.

botRef.description:
Bot to deliver the notification through. The bot determines the
target Discord server.
botRef.title: Bot

buttons.description:
Buttons attached to every message produced by this Notification.
Up to 25 (5 action rows of 5). Buttons let users acknowledge
alarms, drill into details via EQL/HTTP, or trigger workflows
directly from the Discord message.

items.description:
NotificationButton is a Discord message component (button) attached to
every message produced by this Notification. Buttons cannot exceed
Discord limits: 5 action rows of 5 buttons each.

action.description:
Action executed when a user clicks the button. Required for any
non-link style; ignored for style=link.

ackAlarm.description: Acknowledge the alarm or query row that triggered the message.

comment.description:
Optional comment to attach to the alarm acknowledgement. Go
template, evaluated against the click context (user, message).
comment.title: Comment

disableAfterClick.description: Disable the button after a successful ack.
disableAfterClick.title: Disable After Click

ackAlarm.title: Acknowledge

eql.description:
Run an EQL query and reply (ephemeral by default) with the
result.
eql.title: EQL

body.description:
Request body (Go template, evaluated against the command
invocation arguments).
body.title: Body

suppressAlarm.description: Suppress the alarm or query row that triggered the message.

comment.description:
Optional comment to attach to the suppression. Go template,
evaluated against the click context (user, message).
comment.title: Comment

disableAfterClick.description: Disable the button after a successful suppress.
disableAfterClick.title: Disable After Click

duration.description:
How long to suppress the alarm for, e.g. "30m", "4h", "24h".
If empty, the alarm is suppressed indefinitely (until manually
un-suppressed).
duration.title: Duration

suppressAlarm.title: Suppress

workflow.description: Reference to the workflow to trigger.
workflow.title: Workflow

action.title: Action

emoji.description:
Optional emoji shown next to the label. Either a unicode emoji
(e.g. "✅") or a Discord custom emoji in the form 'name:id'.
emoji.title: Emoji

label.description:
Display label shown on the button. Discord limits this to 80
characters.
label.title: Label

style.description:
Visual style of the button. 'link' opens .url in the browser and
produces no interaction; the other styles call back into the bot
with the configured action.
style.title: Style

url.description: Target URL for style=link. Mutually exclusive with .action.
url.title: URL

buttons.title: Buttons

channels.description:
Channel IDs to deliver the notification to. The server is
implied by .spec.botRef (one bot is bound to one server). Each
channel ID must be in the bot's .spec.allowedChannels. If empty,
the bot uses its first allowed channel.
channels.title: Channels

description.description: A user provided description of this Notification.
description.title: Description

exclude.description:
A list of alarm types to exclude. If a source matches both
include and exclude, it will be excluded.
For example: 'InterfaceMemberDown'.
exclude.title: Exclude

include.description:
A list of alarm types to listen to, matching the 'type' field
within alarms. Use the '*' wildcard to include all alarms.
For example: 'InterfaceDown'.
include.title: Include

namespaces.description:
A list of namespaces to listen to. If empty, the notification will
listen to all namespaces.
namespaces.title: Namespaces

query.description: Run a query and notify on each row of its results.

color.description:
Color of notifications generated from this query. Web color names
such as 'red', 'green', 'blue', 'yellow', 'purple', 'gray' are
accepted; rendered as the embed accent in Discord.
color.title: Color

fields.description:
Fields to include in the query results, available to the
template, e.g. '.node.name' or '.node.srl.interface.name'.
fields.title: Fields

table.description: The table to use for the query, e.g. '.namespace.node.srl.interface'.
table.title: Table

template.description:
Go template applied to each result row when sending notifications,
e.g. 'Interface {{ index . "interface.name" }} is down on node
{{ index . "node.name" }}'.
template.title: Template

title.description:
Title used when presenting results for this query, e.g.
'InterfaceDown'.
title.title: Title

where.description:
A where clause for the query, e.g. 'oper-state = down'. Enclosing
parentheses may be omitted.
where.title: Where

query.title: Query
